---
title: "Core CSF proteome"
output: html_document
---

The input table contains the protein-level random-effects detection estimates,
confidence intervals, heterogeneity statistics and leave-one-study-out results.
The analysis reproduces the five recurrence tiers and extracts the Tier A+B
core proteome used in subsequent analyses.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
repo <- if (dir.exists("../scripts")) normalizePath("..") else normalizePath(".")
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = repo)
source(file.path(repo, "scripts", "03_core_proteome.R"))
```

```{r results}
read.delim("analysis/03_core_proteome/core_tier_counts.tsv", check.names = FALSE)
```

The protein list and figure are written to
`analysis/03_core_proteome/`.
